our_title: archCmpltwArchBuild2 frees the caller's weight array on an invalid weight
ran: repro/PS2-G02-1: SCOTCH_archCmpltw (&a, 4, {1,0,1,1}) on a malloc'ed array -> 'archCmpltwArchBuild2: invalid parameters (2)' then 'AddressSanitizer: attempting double-free ... freed by #1 archCmpltwArchBuild2 arch_cmpltw.c:184' when the caller frees its own array (a stack array would corrupt the stack); the freshly allocated vecwtab leaks. Patched (0004): r=1, caller frees its array, exit ok.
evidence: arch_cmpltw.c:182 'if (veloval <= 0) {' :183 'errorPrint ("archCmpltwArchBuild2: invalid parameters (2)");' :184 'memFree    (velotab);' where velotab is the 'const Anum * restrict const' parameter and vecwtab the array allocated at :173.

fix_options.label: A. Free the right array (recommended)
fix_options.tested: repro/PS2-G02-1 pristine fails, patched passes; Builds: 32-bit and 64-bit Gnum ASan+UBSan trees, 0 warnings; every touched file also compiled with -DSCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL. Targets (both word sizes): check_scotch_arch, check_scotch_arch_deco, check_prog_atst, check_prog_amk, check_prog_amk_grf, check_prog_gmk, check_prog_gmap pass with no sanitizer output; check_scotch_arch_build and check_scotch_graph_map show only the pre-existing archDecoArchBuild2 leak and bgraph_bipart_ml.c:195 / kgraph_map_ml.c:239 null-offset UBSan (identical to pristine, other groups). Fuzzing (repro/fuzz, 2000 mutated tleaf/ltleaf/hcub/sub strings, seed 1): pristine 32-bit 29 signatures / 343 hits, 64-bit 36 / 366; with G01 + this series: 32-bit 6 / 152 (all intLoad overflow in common_integer.c:121, another group), 64-bit 3 / 47 (intLoad, plus two arch_sub.c cases listed in extra.json). Series exported with format-patch and re-applied with git am on a fresh v7.0.17 clone after G01's five patches.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: One-token bugfix in his own idiom; the loader twin archCmpltwArchLoad2 frees its own vecwtab correctly at :212.

fix_options.label: B. Validate all weights before allocating
fix_options.summary: Separate check loop, then allocate and fill without an error path.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Two passes over the weights; larger diff.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Fine but more than the bug needs.

our_title: Documented Fortran routine scotchfarchltleaf does not exist
ran: grep -n ARCHLTLEAF src/libscotch/library_arch_f.c -> nothing; nm -D build/lib/libscotch.so | grep -i archltleaf -> only SCOTCH_archLtleaf; doc/src/scotch/s_l.tex:2179-2186 documents scotchfarchltleaf (archdat, levlnbr, sizetab, linktab, permnbr, permtab, ierr).
evidence: s_l.tex:2179 'scotchfarchltleaf ( & doubleprecision (*)    & archdat, \\' ; library_arch_f.c has SCOTCH_FORTRAN (ARCHTLEAF, archtleaf, ... only.

fix_options.label: A. Add the wrapper (recommended, Fortran group)
fix_options.summary: SCOTCH_FORTRAN (ARCHLTLEAF, archltleaf, ...) calling SCOTCH_archLtleaf, placed before ARCHTLEAF.
fix_options.tested: applies, compiles (0 diagnostics); not run from Fortran
fix_options.tradeoffs: None; depends on patch 0001 for the prototype.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Every exported routine has a Fortran twin (library*_f.c); the doc already promises it.

fix_options.label: B. Remove the Fortran paragraph from s_l.tex
fix_options.tested: applies (this diff removes the whole subsection; trimming it to the Fortran tabular is trivial)
fix_options.tradeoffs: Fortran users lose a documented entry point.

our_title: bdgraphBipartEx shifts int 1 by the unbounded sbbt strategy parameter
read_only: bdgraph_bipart_ex.c:139-141 and the STRATPARAMINT entry 'sbbt' in bdgraph_bipart_st.c:144-146 (no range).
why_not_run: Needs a distributed run with a hand-written strategy 'x{sbbt=40}'; outside this group's files (DMO-10's) and build matrix; alt diff provided and compiled with mpicc.
evidence: bdgraph_bipart_ex.c:139 'sbbtnbr = (int) paraptr->sbbtnbr;' :140 'sbbtmsk = (1 << sbbtnbr) - 1;' :141 'gainsiz = ((sizeof (Gnum) << 3) - sbbtnbr) << (sbbtnbr + 1);' with sbbtnbr taken from the user strategy string without bounds.

fix_options.label: A. Bound the parameter and shift a Gnum
fix_options.summary: Reject sbbtnbr < 0 or > bits(Gnum)-2 with an errorPrint, use ((Gnum) 1 << sbbtnbr) - 1.
fix_options.tested: applies, compiles with mpicc -DSCOTCH_PTSCOTCH (0 diagnostics); not run
fix_options.tradeoffs: First range check on a strategy integer parameter in the tree; gainsiz can still be huge for large legal values.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Same class as 6a00c51; he may prefer a range in the strategy parser instead.

fix_options.label: B. Clamp silently
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He prefers explicit errors on invalid user data.

our_title: archSubArchBuild overflows orgtermnbr + 1 for an original architecture of ANUMMAX terminals
ran: repro/fuzz patched 64-bit run: 'sub 1 0 tleaf 1 9223372036854775807 1' -> 'arch_sub.c:409:18: runtime error: signed integer overflow: 9223372036854775807 + 1' (memAlloc ((orgtermnbr + 1) * sizeof (ArchSubTree))); 'sub 1 0 tleaf 1 4294967296 1' -> ASan 'out of memory: allocator is trying to allocate 0x3000000038 bytes' (a legitimate, failing allocation; non-sanitized builds get 'out of memory (2)').
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/arch_sub.c:409 (archSubArchBuild; line 403 in v7.0.17 before G01's series)
evidence: arch_sub.c 'if ((treetab = memAlloc ((orgtermnbr + 1) * sizeof (ArchSubTree))) == NULL) { /* TRICK: One more slot to link to coarser array */' with orgtermnbr = archDomSize of the original architecture, which patch 0002 allows up to ANUMMAX for a tleaf.

fix_options.label: A. Compute the slot count in size_t
fix_options.tested: applies to v7.0.17; not compiled separately (one cast)
fix_options.tradeoffs: The allocation then simply fails; every other 'n * sizeof' in the tree has the same theoretical size_t wrap for n near ANUMMAX.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: G01's file; one-token change in the maintainer's style.

fix_options.label: B. Reject original architectures of ANUMMAX terminals in archSubArchBuild
fix_options.summary: orgtermnbr >= ANUMMAX -> 'invalid number of terminal domains'.

our_title: archHcubDomLoad accepts a negative current dimension (unreachable: archDomLoad has no caller)
read_only: arch_hcub.c:326-331 checks dimncur > dimnnbr only; git grep 'archDomLoad (' finds the definition in arch.c:430 and no call site in src/.
why_not_run: Unreachable from any tool or API.
evidence: arch_hcub.c:328 '(domnptr->dimncur > archptr->dimnnbr)) {' and no 'dimncur < 0' test before archHcubDomSize's '(Anum) 1 << domnptr->dimncur'.

fix_options.label: A. Leave as is
fix_options.summary: No caller; note for the maintainer only.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Dead API; not worth a change.
